intent: Reduce python_pkg/brother_printer/display.py by extracting the parts no test patches, and collapse the duplicated toner/drum bar rendering into one helper. This does NOT bring display.py under the 250-line cap -- it is 342 and needs a further ~92 lines removed, which is blocked on a decision about editing test files.
scope: Non-goal: no assertion changed, no test deleted or weakened
changes: Extracted the supply-level arithmetic into _supply.py: _classify_percentage_level, _classify_supply_level, _format_supply_bar, _process_supply_item, _parse_supply_value, _collect_supply_items. These are imported by the tests, not patched, so they were free to move.
Extracted the three _SEVERITY_* lookup tables into _severity.py. Pure data, patched by nothing.

Added _supply.render_life_bar and used it for both the toner and drum bars in _display_page_count_estimate. Those two blocks were the same logic with different colours and notes -- this removes the duplication rather than just relocating it.
display.py re-exports the moved supply names through __all__, because tests/test_display.py imports them from display.

verification.evidence: 402 passed in 1.76s -- the same count as before the change, run after each of the three extractions.

ruff, ruff format, mypy, pylint, bandit and the coverage-gated pytest all pass. Only the evidence-artifact hook remained, which this file satisfies. No suppression added; a pylint C0104 on the name 'bar' was fixed by renaming it, not disabling the check.
display.py is still 342 lines and remains a violation. Stated explicitly: this commit reduces it and removes real duplication, but does not clear it.

risks: The remaining ~92 lines cannot be extracted without either editing test files or adding ~8 pure-indirection delegate functions. brother_printer's test modules patch roughly 90 names across the package via patch(f'{MOD}.<name>'), and mock.patch pins a name to the module it is patched on: a function that moves to a new module resolves its collaborators through the new module's globals, so the patch no longer reaches it. An earlier attempt to move the page-count block was reverted for exactly this reason (AttributeError: module display does not have the attribute 'estimate_consumable_life').

_display_report_header is patched from both test_display.py and test_display_part2.py, so any split of display.py into USB and network halves has to keep that function reachable from both patch sites.
rollback: git revert the commit; display.py returns to 427 lines and the two new modules are deleted.
After rollback, run python3 -m pytest python_pkg/brother_printer/tests/ -q and confirm it still reports 402 passed.
